card.name: Words just before bacteria or resistance terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words and word pieces where the text is about to mention bacteria, microbes or drug-resistant germs. Typical settings are antibiotic warnings about superinfection and resistance.

modes.label: Superinfection warning
modes.description: The word "appropriate" after "during therapy," in overgrowth-of-organisms warnings.
modes.example: If these infections occur during therapy,<< appropriate>> measures should be taken.

modes.label: Linking words before resistance
modes.description: Words like to, for, the, of that come right before drug-resistant bacteria or superbugs.
modes.example: increases<< the>> risk of development of drug-resistant bacteria.

modes.label: Inside antibiotic or MRSA names
modes.description: A piece partway through antibiotic or methicillin-resistant names.
modes.example: BETA-LACTAM ANTIB<<I>>OTICS HAS BEEN CLEARLY DOCUMENTED
